name: 手绘线稿
summary: 白纸上的墨线手绘，大面积留白，适合讲道理、做对比、讲数量、把两件事连起来，最适合当副风格
summaryEn: black ink lines on white paper with lots of white space; good for explaining, comparisons, amounts and links; best as the second style
look: 白纸上的黑色墨线手绘动画，线条干净、略有手绘抖动，只用少量橙色和浅蓝灰色块点缀，大面积留白。
character: 角色是一个墨线画的简笔玩具机器人，身上用浅蓝灰色块平涂
characterEn: a simple hand-drawn toy robot in black ink lines, filled with flat light blue-grey
ground: 背景是一张干净的白纸
forbid: 画面里没有文字、字母、数字、商标和真实人物，线条不组成任何字，没有人声对白。

refs.prompt: Hand-drawn ink illustration, front view, full body: {character} The head is a smooth round dome with nothing on top: no antenna, no knob, no bolt. Bold, clear, slightly wobbly black ink outlines, drawn large so the robot fills about two thirds of the frame height, centred on a clean white sheet of paper. Nothing is written anywhere in the image, and no line forms a letter or a number.
